data.name: Substance_NoBasisArticle
data.value: No article founds the claim yet. Analyse the facts, tick an article or cite one in your notes, and check that the grounds link the facts to the requests (CPCA art. 15 asks for the grounds of the claim; citing no article number is not in itself a breach of it).

data.name: Substance_TortArticleInContractClaim
data.value: Civil Code art. 124 is liability for fault outside any contract. This claim arises from a contract: base damages on the contract articles instead (art. 176, or art. 186 for late payment of a sum of money).

data.name: Substance_InterestOnPrivateLoan
data.value: Interest is asked on a loan between individuals: Civil Code art. 454 makes such a loan interest-free and any clause to the contrary void.

data.name: Substance_DamagesWithoutFormalNotice
data.value: Damages are asked but the facts mention no formal notice: under Civil Code art. 179, damages are due only after the debtor has been given formal notice, unless the law provides otherwise. Check the notice, or that the law waives it (arts. 180 and 181).

data.name: Help1Body1
data.value: The app helps you write a statement of claim in Arabic in nine steps: court, plaintiff, defendant, subject, facts, legal grounds, requests, documents, and date and signature.

data.name: Help1Body2
data.value: The petition takes shape with every change. At legal grounds, an AI model running on your computer reads the facts and suggests a claim type and legal articles. You confirm the claim type and choose articles, then it drafts the grounds. Review the draft and export it to PDF or Word.

data.name: Help1Body3
data.value: No data leaves your computer. The app works offline.

data.name: Help2Title
data.value: What AI does and does not do

data.name: Help2Body1
data.value: It reads the facts you entered and suggests a claim type and articles from the bundled legal library.

data.name: Help2Body2
data.value: No suggestion is adopted before you confirm it: confirm the claim type first, then choose articles.

data.name: Help2Body3
data.value: The program supplies the legal rule and article number. AI writes only the sentences applying them to your case facts.

data.name: Help2Body4
data.value: Every AI-written section is marked and must be reviewed before export.

data.name: Help2Body5
data.value: AI does not give legal advice or guarantee the outcome. You are responsible for the petition you sign.

data.name: Help3Body1
data.value: The formal check verifies required petition details, such as party identities, court and signature. It checks form only: completion does not mean the claim is admissible or well founded.

data.name: Help3Body2
data.value: The petition’s formal section cites the articles governing petition form in the Code of Civil and Administrative Procedure. Review it like the rest of the petition.

data.name: Help3Body3
data.value: Legal review points flag matters that may need attention, such as a missing legal basis or incomplete date. These notes help you; the decision is yours.

data.name: Help4Body1
data.value: Export is blocked while something still needs completion before filing: an unreviewed AI section, an unfilled “(...)” placeholder, or text too long for its field. “Before export” lists what remains. Completing it lifts the block.

data.name: Help5Body1
data.value: Save your case with Save or Ctrl+S. Open it later with Open or from recent cases on Home.

data.name: Help5Body2
data.value: The app keeps a recovery copy while you work. After an unexpected close, it offers to resume your previous session.

data.name: Help5Body3
data.value: Before starting a new case or opening another, the app asks if you have unsaved changes.

data.name: Help5Body4
data.value: Removing a case from recent cases does not delete its file.

data.name: Help6Body6
data.value: Esc — Close the window, tour or help

data.name: Help7Body1
data.value: The app quotes articles only from its bundled legal library, not from AI memory.

data.name: Help7Body2
data.value: Some laws are complete. Others contain only the articles used by the app’s supported claim types.

data.name: Help7Body3
data.value: Each law has two indicators: how it was transcribed and compared with its official source, and whether a lawyer reviewed it.

data.name: Help7Body4
data.value: You can open each law’s official source and mention unbundled articles in your notes.
